title: Conflicting accounts of who sent Puharich to Israel (foundation vs CIA)

tellings.quote: And then Geller himself said, oh, yeah, no, he he was sent by the CIA, like directly.

plain: Around 1970 to 1971 a researcher named Andrija Puharich went to Tel Aviv, Israel, and the accounts disagree on who sent him: a private foundation, or the CIA. A researcher named Greg Malatzi lays out the contradiction on the show. He sets Puharich's own lectures against the Israeli psychic Uri Geller, who, Malatzi says, claimed "he was sent by the CIA, like directly." If Geller is right, the trip would have been an intelligence operation and not private research.
